lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of approximately 65 high-luminance, roughly circular blobs is visible on the mid-lateral flank, organized into roughly seven primary vertical columns between the pectoral fin and the start of the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of blobs, creating a distinct matrix of high-luminance anchor nodes where the horizontal rows of spots intersect these vertical pale stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal carinae are visible on the dorsal-lateral flank, each characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring a high-intensity upper edge and a shadowed lower margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a high density of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated along the anterior leading edge and the base, while the upper-mid lateral surface contains a unique, large, low-contrast spiral pigmentation pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique, large spiral-shaped pigment arrangement is visible on the upper half of the first dorsal fin; additionally, several commensal fish (remoras) are visible in the lower third of the frame near the pectoral fin and ventral margin.
